rows.ARS:
Dark red Floribunda.
Registration name: Janice Kellogg ®
Exhibition name: Janice Kellogg ®
rows.Bloom: Crimson and purple. None to mild fragrance. 41 petals. Large, very full (41+ petals), old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden or landscape. Very vigorous. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
